NO people, NO rescuers, NO other vessels, NO text/logos/watermark. Exactly one half-submerged empty wooden boat, clearly ROYAL BLUE identifying stripe, app-ready transparent sprite.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE true transparent RGBA 3D game sprite to replace an unnatural vertical sinking boat. Reference 1 gives the small rounded honey-brown wooden sailboat design and royal-blue identifying hull stripe, NOT the people. Reference 2 gives render style only. Scene: abandoned boat naturally HALF SUNK in the sea, no crew. CRITICAL physical pose: long hull axis close to HORIZONTAL, just a gentle 15-degree bow-down pitch. The forward HALF OF THE BOAT IS COMPLETELY UNDER THE IMPLIED WATER SURFACE AND INVISIBLE; ONLY the rear half remains above the water, low in the water with the open stern interior flooded. The waterline visibly cuts diagonally across the midsection at realistic sea level. Show partial exposed stern hull with royal BLUE stripe, rear bench and wet planks; the lower hull, bow, keel and rudder disappear below waterline, do not draw them. Broken short mast lies low across flooded deck, slack small torn blue-and-white sail mostly submerged. This must look like a grounded realistic half-submerged wreck, not an intact boat hovering, not a vertical nose-up vessel, not fully upside down. Match softly realistic app-boat 3D render, elevated front three-quarter view, natural diffuse daylight, wood grain and small brass fittings. TRUE transparent background for overlay on live ocean: no ocean background, no large water patch, no backdrop or glow, all pixels outside the exposed boat and a narrow irregular semi-transparent foam waterline are alpha zero. Tiny hints of water trapped INSIDE boat are allowed. Exposed half-boat fully within frame, compact centered sprite with comfortable transparent margin. No people, no rescue boat, no text, no logos, no watermark. Single BLUE hull stripe, not other colors. Natural sinking physics and restrained proportions are highest priority.
